name: Feathers and Fleece
intro: Crops are all very well, but a farm wants animals. Here's a chick - raise her in a cell of your plot, keep her fed on barley, and she'll lay for you. Bring in her first eggs and I'll find you a lamb.

steps.text: Raise the chick in your plot (Z picks what F plants)
Keep her fed with barley and collect her eggs

outro: Fresh eggs! Mara will buy them, or pack them in a Farmhouse Hamper and they'll fetch far more abroad. Take this lamb - the same rules apply.
